title: Exosome isolation from serum using ExoQuick reagent
protocol: Transfer 200 µl of serum into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 50 μl of ExoQuick Exosome Precipitation Solution to the serum.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the ExoQuick/serum mixture at 1,500 × g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down residual ExoQuick solution by centrifugation at 1,500 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove all traces of fluid by aspiration without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 20 μl sterile PBS.
